explain_task.question: Using the revised LP-relaxation diagnostics together with `src/current_heuristic.py` and, where helpful, `src/formulation.tex`, explain which revised constraints are binding and what their shadow prices mean in business terms. Your answer must name the exact code constraints and variables (for example `Prod_Hours_1`, `Inv_Balance_A_1`, `inv_A[1]`, `sales_A[2]`, `promo_A[2]`, `extra_rev_A[2]`), trace them back to the exact `general_parameters.csv` fields and values they use (including `max_production_hours_week_1 = 40`, `profit_per_kg_product_A = 30`, and the storage carry-over terms), and explain why the LP-relaxation marginal value for week-1 hours cannot be linearly extrapolated to the integer optimum. Then compare original vs revised and identify the exact code additions/modifications that created the objective jump from `146.667` to `337.333`, including the business motivation from the revision brief and a quantitative decomposition of how carry-over inventory plus promotions changed the economics relative to the original `x_A`/`x_B` model.
